# tests/fixtures/win_abi_frames/classes.txt -- #143 option C golden frame
# classification (spec 2.5.5, finding 21; plan A19g). For every function of
# the frames corpus and of the mixed fault fixtures, on each backend: its
# class (SP-fixed: no frame register; SP-moving: a frame register) and, for
# arm64 IR, its shape (S1, S2 or D; spec 2.5.3). Row
# pe_unwind_win_frame_classes builds each fixture for Windows (--emit=pe,
# --test-listing; tests/helpers/win_frame_classes.py reads the class from the
# bytes) and fails on any difference in either direction -- so a frame
# pointer where none is needed (which C3b allows) fails too. Change a line
# only with its reason in the commit that changes it.
#
# Why the SP-moving ones are SP-moving:
#   x64 IR: call10/rec10/a_ten pass 10 arguments (X3); page_frame/big_frame/
#     a_page zero their local arrays with op 76 (memset), which is not on the
#     audited allow-list; rspcheck and checks hold asm blocks (X14); main is
#     the freestanding entry with asm; mixed b calls c with 7 arguments (X3);
#     mixed main is a hosted main (X15).
#   x64 legacy: rspcheck/checks asm (L9); mixed b println (L7); main hosted
#     or asm (L10/L9). Every call area is folded (ruling Q11).
#   arm64 IR: page_frame/big_frame/a_page memset (op 76); rspcheck asm (A5);
#     main asm or hosted (A4/A5); mixed b asm. S2 where a save offset would
#     pass 504 (one spill slot per vreg), else S1.
#   arm64 legacy: rspcheck/main asm or hosted (G5/G6); mixed b asm.
# The perf ports (tests/perf/, A15; plan A15, A19e-h review finding 3), arm64
# IR, --freestanding, each built with its exit_arm64.kr: fib S1; sha256 rotr
# S1, block S2, digest S2, k_init S2 (spec 2.5.3's prediction). Only these
# functions are compared for a "+" fixture (the exit helpers are harness).
#
